description: PyLESA, published by andrewlyden, models local electricity and heat systems with heat pumps, thermal storage, time-of-use tariffs and predictive control using Python and spreadsheet inputs. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The author explicitly identifies the tool as a doctoral-project output; proposed future battery and balancing features are not treated as implemented. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
